notes.title: Play Gun Blaze - win a prize for the Zone!
notes.notes:
Attention! All fighters who participating in the tests of the new shooter Gun Blaze!

Anyone who get 50 wins in Gun Blaze will receive a valuable prize on their Anomaly Zone account!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157250/Anomaly_Zone/

We remind you that if you play on the RU server, you need to link your account to Steam, or your victories will not be count!

Keep in mind that it's a limited time offer!
